    - Sorcha. Agna's girl, Calder's wife, mother of two little terrors. That's the Sea Thrift on the shingle there, my father's boat. More patches than planks, my mother says, and she patched most of them.

    - Still rough past the point. But I can beach the Thrift on the Strandwood shingle again and gut there while the tide turns, and that's thanks to you. The children still stay inshore.
